## Use Case

Use this template when an agent needs user-authorized access to external services such as Google, GitHub, Slack, or Notion.

## Prerequisites

- Charm CLI.
- Nango configured for the provider.
- Store and runner configured with matching Nango environment variables.

## Configuration Surface

Document these fields:

- `auth.providers`
- `auth.providers[].name`
- `auth.providers[].scopes`
- provider-specific access token environment variables

## Run and Publish

```bash
charm validate
charm push
```
